caption: Press the button and one of the two outputs turns on at random, each half the time, and stays on until the next press picks again. Inside, two droppers face each other: one holds an iron shovel (the token), the other a cobblestone. A press fires both in the same tick; whichever fires first hands its item over, and the other then fires one of its two items back at random, so the shovel ends in either dropper with chance 1/2 whatever came before. A comparator reads each dropper (2 with the shovel, 1 with the cobblestone), two dusts bring that down to 1 or 0, and a repeater lights the output while the shovel is there.

Press the button and one of the four outputs turns on at random, each a quarter of the time, and stays on until the next press picks again. Two coin flips do the picking: each is a pair of droppers facing each other, one holding an iron shovel and the other a cobblestone, both fired by the same press, so the shovel ends up in either dropper with chance 1/2. One pair sits on the ground and the other two blocks up, crossing over it. A comparator reads one dropper of each pair (2 with the shovel, 1 with the cobblestone) and two dusts drop that to 1 or 0. Each output is a subtracting comparator one block up, between a dust from each pair: it lights when its rear dust is 1 and its side dust is 0. The four rear/side combinations give the four outcomes, and all of them change in the same tick, so no other output ever flickers on.
